arg.name: configuration_package
arg.description: Description package with robot URDF/xacro files. Usually not set, it enables use of a custom description.

arg.name: description_file
arg.description: URDF/XACRO description file with the robot.

arg.name: robot_1_ip
arg.description: IP address of the left robot.

arg.name: robot_1_is_async
arg.description: Run Franka driver in a separate thread (Necessary for real robot control)

arg.name: robot_1_cpu_affinity
arg.description: Pin Franka driver to RT cores (cores 2,3 on CtrlX)

arg.name: robot_1_scheduling_policy
arg.description: Franka Driver scheduling polic. Slave - wait on robot signal to start read/write

arg.name: robot_2_ip
arg.description: IP address of the right robot.

arg.name: robot_2_is_async
arg.description: Run Franka driver in a separate thread (Necessary for real robot control)

arg.name: robot_2_cpu_affinity
arg.description: Pin Franka driver to RT cores (cores 2,3 on CtrlX)

arg.name: robot_2_scheduling_policy
arg.description: Franka Driver scheduling polic. Slave - wait on robot signal to start read/write

let.name: robot_description
let.value: $(command '$(find-exec xacro) $(find-pkg-share $(var configuration_package))/urdf/$(var description_file).urdf.xacro \ robot_1_ros2_control_hardware_type:=$(var robot_1_ros2_control_hardware_type) \ robot_1_prefix:=$(var robot_1_prefix) \ robot_1_ip:=$(var robot_1_ip) \ robot_1_is_async:=$(var robot_1_is_async) \ robot_1_cpu_affinity:=$(var robot_1_cpu_affinity) \ robot_1_thread_priority:=$(var robot_1_thread_priority) \ robot_1_scheduling_policy:=$(var robot_1_scheduling_policy) \ robot_2_ros2_control_hardware_type:=$(var robot_2_ros2_control_hardware_type) \ robot_2_prefix:=$(var robot_2_prefix) \ robot_2_ip:=$(var robot_2_ip) \ robot_2_is_async:=$(var robot_2_is_async) \ robot_2_cpu_affinity:=$(var robot_2_cpu_affinity) \ robot_2_thread_priority:=$(var robot_2_thread_priority) \ robot_2_scheduling_policy:=$(var robot_2_scheduling_policy)')
